chat.line.hover.about: A chat line under the pointer. The chevron lights toward a lighter shade of its speaker's colour, then steps a pixel right; the words follow three pixels, one after another, the row stretching by its gaps while they travel (gap: pixels across the row). Leaving is quicker: the words go back first and the chevron follows.

chat.line.appear.about: The newest message: the stack rises into place while the line slides in from the side, past its place and back, fading in a little ahead of the motion.

chat.bar.appear.about: The input bars coming up from below as the chat opens, with a small swing as they land.

chat.picker.open.about: A picker panel opening from its button and closing back into it.

chat.tab.move.about: A tab gliding to its place and width in the row.

chat.tab.controls.about: A tab's own controls going and coming as the row narrows and widens: the room glides in one half, the ink fades in the other.

chat.row.move.about: A row of the history gliding to its place when the lines are laid out again.

chat.row.appear.about: A row new to the history's layout fading in where it lands.

chat.snap.assist.about: The snap assist's panes coming and going.

chat.snap.layouts.about: The snap layouts' flyout coming and going, the snap bar fading in and out, and the bar coming all the way down from its peek once the pointer touches it, and back.

chat.snap.preview.about: The frosted preview of where a window will snap, growing out of the window and fading.

chat.search.clear.about: The search well's magnifier crossing over to its cross while a search stands in it.

chat.window.fill.about: A window gliding to the part of the screen it fills, and back.

chat.window.area.about: A window's timestamp area driven out and back in.

chat.window.members.about: A window's member list coming out and going back in.

chat.jump.show.about: The jump-to-present button flying in while a history is scrolled back, and out again.

chat.toolbar.show.about: A message's toolbar coming up after a scroll: it stays away while the history moves, waits until the pointer has rested on one message for 'rest' milliseconds, then fades in. The rest is the pointer's, so the Animations settings leave it as it is.

chat.icon.flip.about: A chevron control playing its run of frames between open and closed.

chat.feed.typing.about: The closed feed's lines rising a row for its typing row, and settling back.

chat.scroll.about: A history, list or panel gliding to where it was scrolled: most of the way in this many seconds.

chat.hover.fade.about: A row or control crossing to its lit shade and back.

chat.marquee.return.about: A name cut short gliding home once the pointer leaves it.

chat.snap.bar.peek.about: The snap bar peeking further down from the top of the screen as a carried window's pointer comes nearer it, and back up: most of the way in this many seconds.
